text:
lucy.marketing: Quick check  we need a micro-runbook for tomorrow's webinar + short launch post. Items: final KW list, tiny JSON-LD (Event + VideoObject + FAQ), internal link push list, and redirect tidy. Can @ian_seo + @marta_ops cover? draft: https://tiny.redwood/launch-lift

ian_seo: On it. Propose canonical https://redwood.com/learn/launch-lift-bench. Seed KWs: "LLM inference benchmarks", "inference latency benchmark", "cost per token benchmark". I'll add 4 longtails and anchor suggestions.

marta_ops: I'll run a redirect-scan and schedule cutover window with eng-release. Need list of legacy promo paths.

lucy.marketing: Legacy paths we found: /benchpromo, /bench-lp-2022, /bench-old. Some are 302s. Prefer 301 -> canonical. UTM for emails: ?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_lift

redirect-bot: redirect-scan: /benchpromo -> 302 -> /promo/old, /bench-lp-2022 -> 410, /bench-old -> 302 -> /blog/legacy-bench. Recommendation: 301 /benchpromo -> /learn/launch-lift-bench and 301 /bench-old -> /learn/launch-lift-bench. Commands: `redirect-plan --create 301 /benchpromo /learn/launch-lift-bench`

gabi_release: I'll open ticket REL-5333 for redirect consolidation + canonical swap. Proposed cutover Tue 10:00 PT, rollback 10:30 PT. Will attach QA steps.

ian_seo: Longtails (quick): "batch-size latency tradeoffs for LLM inference", "quantized model latency comparisons", "reduce inference cost per request", "benchmarking dedicated GPU pools". Anchor map: "batching and latency tradeoffs" -> /docs/batching, "inference pricing examples" -> /pricing, "dedicated inference case study" -> /case-studies. Use descriptive anchors only.

marta_ops: REL-5333 created and assigned to eng-release. I'll post cutover to #release-war-room. QA checklist: 1) Screaming Frog crawl for redirect chains; 2) schema validator (https://validator.schema.org) on the final page; 3) confirm rel=canonical set to canonical URL; 4) mobile UA smoke.

ian_seo: I'll paste a minimal JSON-LD bundle into the doc: Event (webinar) + VideoObject (recording, transcript link) + short FAQ (2 Qs). Note: set `mainEntityOfPage` to canonical and avoid UTMs in schema.

lucy.marketing: Perfect. Action items: ian finalize KW + paste JSON-LD, marta run redirects + QA, gabi run release ticket. Ping here when done and we'll lock promo. :rocket:
